name: Ebara Corporation
summary: Ebara Corporation manufactures and sells pumps, compressors, turbines, and chillers in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, Japan, Oceania, North America, and Central and South America. It operates through the Building Service & Industrial, Energy, Infrastructure, Environmental Solutions, and Precision Machinery segments. The company offers standard and custom pumps, fans, booster pump units, chillers, cooling towers, and heating and cooling machines; and cryogenic products. It also provides incineration systems, gasification technologies, municipal and industrial waste treatment plants, municipal waste processing plants, and boilers, as well as sewerage and drainage treatment systems.
